cohort: The study included 186 pregnant women whose HbA1c levels were measured in the first-trimester.
finding: The study found that first-trimester HbA1c greater than 5.2% was the best cutoff to predict GDM, and higher HbA1c levels were significantly associated with increased maternal and fetal complications, including GDM, PIH, macrosomia, and polyhydramnios.
followup_time: Throughout pregnancy and until delivery (approximately up to 40 weeks of gestation)
